name: ERCC excision repair 5, endonuclease
pathways: double-strand break repair via homologous recombination

function.text: ERCC5 encodes DNA excision repair protein ERCC-5. Annotated molecular activities include endonuclease activity and DNA endonuclease activity. It participates in transcription-coupled nucleotide-excision repair and double-strand break repair via homologous recombination.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to xeroderma pigmentosum group G (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
